name: agent-stoplight
description: Traffic lights for AI coding agents: stop parallel Claude Code sessions from overwriting each other's files.

strict.title: Strict claims
strict.description: Claim files with an atomic mkdir: never two owners, but the first edit of each file is slower (about 200 ms on Windows). Turn it on in every session that shares the repository.

hold.title: Hold files for
hold.description: turn (default): while Claude works on a task, then 2 more minutes. idle: until a file goes 10 minutes untouched. session: until the session ends.

auto_resume.title: Resume waiting sessions automatically
auto_resume.description: When a session was refused a file, wake it up with a prompt as soon as the file is free, so it carries on without you. Each resume is one more Claude turn.

guard_shell.title: Guard shell commands
guard_shell.description: Also refuse Bash and PowerShell commands that would write a file another session holds (redirects, tee, sed -i, mv, cp, rm, git checkout, Set-Content, ...). Best effort.
